searchPhrases.cypher: MATCH (n)-[r]->(m) RETURN n, r, m LIMIT 100
MATCH (p1:Person)-[:USES_DEVICE]->(d:Device)<-[:USES_DEVICE]-(p2:Person) WHERE p1.person_id < p2.person_id RETURN p1, d, p2

searchPhrases.phrase: Find people sharing a phone number
searchPhrases.cypher: MATCH (p1:Person)-[:HAS_PHONE]->(ph:PhoneNumber)<-[:HAS_PHONE]-(p2:Person) WHERE p1.person_id < p2.person_id RETURN p1, ph, p2
MATCH (p1:Person)-[:LIVES_AT]->(ad:Address)<-[:LIVES_AT]-(p2:Person) WHERE p1.person_id < p2.person_id RETURN p1, ad, p2

MATCH path = (a1:Account)-[:SENT]->(:Transaction)-[:TO]->(a2:Account)-[:SENT]->(:Transaction)-[:TO]->(a3:Account)-[:SENT]->(:Transaction)-[:TO]->(a1) WHERE a1.account_id < a2.account_id AND a1.account_id < a3.account_id RETURN path
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.risk_score >= 80 MATCH path = (p)-[*1..4]-(nearby) WHERE nearby:Account OR nearby:Person RETURN path LIMIT 25

searchPhrases.phrase: Shortest path from A300 to A700
searchPhrases.cypher: MATCH (start:Account {account_id: 'A300'}), (end:Account {account_id: 'A700'}) MATCH path = shortestPath((start)-[*..8]-(end)) RETURN path
MATCH (p:Person)-[:OWNS]->(a:Account) WHERE a.status = 'flagged' OR p.risk_score >= 75 RETURN p, a
